nodes.label: Triggered Countdown Display
nodes.rationale: Device simplified from standalone Todoist client to triggered countdown display showing idle clock or big digits.

nodes.label: Two-Zone Touch Gesture Mapping
nodes.rationale: Screen split vertically at x=240: left hold logs and stops, right tap extends 5m, right hold completes.

nodes.label: USB Serial JSON Protocol
nodes.rationale: Direct Web Serial over USB CDC at 115200 baud replaces BLE/HTTP/relay because BLE starved IRAM/heap and caused display flicker, while Web Serial works from HTTPS deploy without local relay.

nodes.label: Optimistic Todoist Sync
nodes.rationale: Mutations are optimistic with rollback; when offline they queue locally and flush on reconnect.

nodes.label: Todoist OAuth PKCE Auth
nodes.rationale: Bearer tokens stored in browser localStorage with auto-refresh via PKCE, zero secrets stored on client.

nodes.label: Firmware v1 Direct Companion Design
nodes.rationale: v1 architecture had ESP32 talk directly to Todoist REST API over WiFi/HTTPS with manual API token.

nodes.label: ESP32 USB Serial Companion Migration
nodes.rationale: BLE and WiFi/TLS starved IRAM/heap causing 480x320 display flicker; app now drives device over Web Serial with polling SPI and no active radios.
